extras: Desktop only; must be launched from an already-opened vault; supports bilingual UI (English / 中文).
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that creates a new vault by cloning the configuration of an existing one.
problem: Manually setting up a new vault with the desired theme, hotkeys, and plugin configurations is time-consuming.
summary: A tool that creates a new Obsidian vault by copying the configuration, theme, and settings from an existing local vault.
